```lean
by
  -- The forgetful functor from RingCat to AddCommGrpCat factors through CommMonCat
  -- and preserves limits, so we can use the right adjointness of the components.
  obtain ⟨f, η, ε, unit, counit, adj⟩ :=
    CategoryTheory.RightAdjoint.ofPreservesLimits
      (CategoryTheory.forget₂ RingCat AddCommGrpCat)
      (RingCat.forget₂AddCommGroup_preservesLimits)
      (CategoryTheory.Forget₂.rightAdjointOfPreservesLimits
        (CategoryTheory.forget₂ RingCat CommMonCat)
        (CategoryTheory.Forget₂.rightAdjointOfPreservesLimits
          (CategoryTheory.forget CommMonCat)
          (CommMonCat.instIsRightAdjointForgetMonoidHomCarrier)))
```
